limitations: Every numerical acoustic/material/scheduling parameter is an authored demonstration value, not calibrated ENP3 metadata.
Known synthetic pose and well axis are supplied; no proprietary pose estimation or eccentricity compensation is implemented.
Three independent monostatic returns; no cross-talk, waveform DSP, diffraction, elastic wave simulation or acoustic-face certification.
108 output bins and 108 quasi-static orientations per depth are explicitly chosen demonstration sampling, not manufacturer shot cadence or instrument resolution.
Received echo strength depends on material AND stand-off/incidence; colormaps remain separate quantities.
Weak/missed echoes stay invalid; interpolation is disabled by default. No field imagery, live telemetry, operational safety or formation classification.
